How do you get a good grade under NQH?
-> Attend all the classes with utmost concentration (Never miss a class). Listen to his analogies and try to make notes of those. Most of all, try to understand what he is saying, and that alone will help you understand the slides later. Go through the slides after the class, try to understand everything, and relate it to the class lectures. Lastly, try to collect questions from the past semesters because those help in understanding the question pattern. If you get lucky, you might also get some questions common in the examination. If you follow these suggestions, you will easily get a good mark in the exams, and if you can outperform most of the students in the section, you can hope to get a good grade.
How is he as a person?
-> He is a good teacher, and I really like his personality. Honestly, I liked how he gave examples that relate to the topics he discusses in the class. His examples are interesting and informative, and I rarely felt bored in his classes.
I got an A-. I could've done better if I weren't so lazy and uncommitted. I even thought of dropping the course before the mid-term because I was so unprepared. However, I decided to try anyway and got 58 out of 80 (which is bad, I know. However, the average mark of the section was somewhere around 25, which motivated me to keep going). Thus, I continued and thought I would give my best in the final exam. I got 87 out of 100 (probably the second-highest mark in the final exam). If I had been this serious before the mid-term, I indeed would've gotten an A. Why is this paragraph for? It's because it's not impossible or hard even to get a good grade under NQH if you are motivated enough.
